trainer/30501.htm.text: Prefect Kasman: Have you come here to learn? Heed my advice: do your best, then use your power to bring justice to those Low Orcs .

trainer/30501-1.htm.text: Prefect Kasman: They were rebels we defeated long ago. They have so long been exiled from our civilization that they can hardly be termed Orcs any more. It is difficult for me to even accept the fact that they have the same origin as the rest of our kind. We must purge them with the sacred flames o…

trainer/30501-noteach.htm.text: Prefect Kasman: I, Kasman, have nothing to teach you. Go seek out a Master who is right for you!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30501-01.html.text: Prefect Kasman: My friend, this reconstruction of the Orc Kingdom that you have undertaken is truly the Lord's work! I can tell you whatever you need to know about the apostate Orcs around here.

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30501-11.html.text: Prefect Kasman: The time has come for all of the 108 tribes to reunite under our Flame Lord! The world trembles before the glorious kingdom of Orc! All praise the great Flame Lord Kakai! Tejakar Oroka!
when: state STARTED; has items 3216,3217,3220; lacks items 3209,3210

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30501-01.html.text: Prefect Kasman: I have received notice from Karukia. You were given the task to destroy the betrayers, right? They are sly scoundrels, so you must be careful in dealing with them. After you finish your task, bring me back their heads!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30501-02.html.text: Prefect Kasman: Now you have one left. Go and kill the scoundrel!

Q00415_PathOfTheOrcMonk/30501-01.html.text: Prefect Kasman: To find the second scroll needed in order to become a Monk, you must meet Khavatari Toruku . To meet him, you must follow the path that heads north from the village. He will be near the fork in the road. When you meet him, give him this fig. Come back after you have completed his Tr…

Q00415_PathOfTheOrcMonk/30501-02.html.text: Prefect Kasman: Why have you returned? If you want to find the scroll, go on now to Khavatari Toruku He is near the three-way junction if you follow the road north of the village. When you secure the Iron Will Scroll, come back to me.

Q00415_PathOfTheOrcMonk/30501-03.html.text: Prefect Kasman: You have met Khavatari Toruku! They say that his tasks can be completed only with iron will and determination! That's no problem for one like you, right?

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30501-03.html.text: Prefect Kasman: Take the letter I gave you to the Chief of the Vuku tribe . You will find him cowering in a forest near the Town of Gludio . Go and reclaim the Scepter of Flame from those lowlifes!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30501-09.html.text: Prefect Kasman: A man claiming to be the Chief of the Lennunt tribe is currently on the southern seashore of Gludio . Take this letter to him. Don't forget that you are the representative of the greatest Flame Lord, Kakai and you must always display the pride and dignity befitting your position!

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
